claims.claim: AGoQ combines layer-aware activation quantization and precision-preserved gradient quantization within Megatron-LM-style distributed training (Section 3).
claims.limitation: The source path is verified, but no distributed training run was performed.

claims.claim: Layer-aware activation quantization reduces cached activation memory for a transformer layer from 28U in BF16 and 16.5U in COAT to 7.75U (Table 1).
claims.limitation: This is exact arithmetic over paper-transcribed Table 1 components, not a measured runtime allocation.

claims.claim: Dynamic Bit-width Compensation for Pipeline Parallelism assigns higher activation bit-widths to underutilized pipeline stages while maintaining near-4-bit activation storage (Section 4.2).
claims.limitation: The paper does not specify the integer rounding policy; its reported allocation overshoots the nominal target by one storage unit.

claims.claim: Kernel fusion combines quantization/dequantization with adjacent GEMM operations to reduce activation-quantization overhead (Figure 4).
claims.limitation: Call-site adjacency is present, but the fused kernel body and measured overhead reduction are unavailable.

claims.claim: On LLaMA2-13B sequence lengths from 32K to 80K, AGoQ reports faster training than Megatron-LM and ZeRO-1 while avoiding activation recomputation in the listed settings (Table 2).
claims.limitation: Unavailable: Table 2 requires 64 GPUs and no distributed training was run.

claims.claim: AGoQ reports lower memory than COAT and comparable or faster training time on OLMo-1B at 24K and 32K sequence lengths (Table 3).
claims.limitation: Unavailable: Table 3 requires 16 NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs and no training was run.

source_audit.detail: Megatron tensor-parallel layers call the pinned activation quantizer, whose gact path calls op_quantize and op_dequantize.
The pinned gradient path performs All-to-All, local dequantize/reduce/requantize, and AllGather operations.
The pinned DDP path dequantizes, accumulates locally, and requantizes.
The release contains interleaved pipeline scheduling context but no source implementation of the paper's discrete bit-allocation rule.
Pinned Transformer Engine changes contain quantize/dequantize call sites next to GEMM calls, but no gact kernel body proving a single fused kernel.
